title: A Walk in the Forest
text:
Anna likes nature. Every Sunday, she walks in the forest near her house. The forest has tall trees and many birds. Anna often sees rabbits and squirrels.

Last week, Anna saw a lot of trash on the ground. She picked it up and put it in a bin. Now she wants to keep the forest clean. She tells her friends to help her.

questions.text: What does Anna do every Sunday?
options: She walks in the forest near her house.

questions.text: What did Anna do with the trash?
options: She left it on the ground.
She gave it to her friends.
She put it in a bin.

questions.text: Why does Anna want to keep the forest clean?
options: She wants to sell the trees.
She is angry with her friends.

questions.text: What can the reader infer about Anna?
options: She is someone who helps protect the environment.
She does not visit the forest.
She works in a city office.

vocabulary.definition: a large area covered with trees
things that you throw away because you do not want them
small animals with bushy tails that live in trees

paragraph_translations: A Anna le gusta la naturaleza. Cada domingo camina en el bosque cerca de su casa. El bosque tiene árboles altos y muchos pájaros. Anna a menudo ve conejos y ardillas.
La semana pasada, Anna vio mucha basura en el suelo. La recogió y la puso en un contenedor. Ahora quiere mantener el bosque limpio. Le dice a sus amigos que la ayuden.
